description:
Turn on, change or pause recurring citation monitoring for a site: AuditAE re-asks its buyer questions on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews every week (or month), keeps every answer, and emails the account owner when the brand gains or loses a citation. Read what moved with get_changes (free). One schedule per site — the same one as the dashboard's "Track weekly"; calling again updates it.

Billing: free to schedule; when it runs, 5–12¢ per engine check for each question × engine answered, plus a fix-it playbook for each answered check that didn't cite the brand, billed on LLM usage (about 12¢ each), plus about 45¢ for the audit rollup, plus a 25¢ saved report per run. cost_per_run_cents is the estimate (checks exact, the playbook about — from the last run's uncited share once it has run, else every check lost); say it and the monthly estimate to the user and call only after they agree. A run that finds the workspace out of credit pauses the schedule.

Inputs:
  site_id — from list_sites; or domain instead.
  prompts — buyer questions to watch (max 25); they become the site's tracked questions. Omit to keep the site's own (or its latest audit's).
  engines — optional; default the four core engines (ai-mode is opt-in, 10¢/check).
  cadence — weekly (default) | monthly.
  paused — true pauses it (history kept), false resumes.

Returns { monitor_id, site_id, domain, status: active|paused, cadence, next_run_at, last_run_at, prompts, engines, created, checks_per_run, cost_per_run_cents, cost_breakdown_cents: {checks, playbook, saved_report}, monthly_estimate_cents, next_step }. Runs happen on the daily 06:00 UTC pass.

Example: { site_id: "…", prompts: ["best invoicing app for freelancers"], cadence: "weekly" }

cadence.description: How often to run. Default weekly.

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "acme.com" — instead of site_id.

engines.description: Engines to ask. Default: the four core engines.

paused.description: true pauses monitoring, false resumes it.

prompts.description: Buyer questions to watch (max 25). Omit to keep the site's tracked questions.

name: monitor_citations
title: Monitor a site's AI citations weekly or monthly
